items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: It was Eric Winstone’s big band

ctx.x: Nobody would teach me. The only person that was playing vibes then was a man called Roy Marsh. He was working with one of these big bands. It was Eric Winstone’s big band, and three or four of the guys in the band, they came to the theater to play, and three or four of them came down to hear me play at this little ballroom where I was working in the small group and playing vibes on the side. And I asked Roy Marsh if he would teach me then and he said no, he wouldn’t teach me. So I had to make my own way. And I…
If someone asked you, if they came up and said, “Can you play ‘These Foolish Things’” for instance, and you didn’t know it but you said, I better learn that song, how did you go about it back then?
